knowledge:
- key_parameters: m=Numeric matrix of peptide intensities where 0s are replaced with NAs and values are log2-transformed ;; treatment=Factor vector indicating the treatment group for each sample column in m ;; prot.info=Data frame containing peptide metadata, where the first column must be unique peptide IDs (sequences) and other columns contain protein/gene IDs ;; h.c=Integer in the eig_norm1 output representing the number of bias trends to eliminate during normalization ;; pr_ppos=Integer indicating the column index of the Protein Identifier in the metadata data frame ;; my.pi=Numeric value (default 0.05) representing the proportion of missing observations that are missing completely at random ;; nperm=Integer specifying the number of permutations for the significance test (should be 500+ for publication) ;; prot_col_name=Character string specifying the column name of the protein identifier used to match proteins across datasets
- alternatives: Multi-dataset t-test=Requires averaging or "rolling-up" peptide abundances into protein abundances prior to analysis, which reduces statistical power and the ability to detect differentially expressed proteins ;; Standard Benjamini-Hochberg adjustment (p.adjust with method='BH')=Inappropriate for the permutation test p-values because they do not follow the theoretical uniform distribution; the package's built-in BH_P_val (which stretches out values on the [0, 1] interval) should be used instead
- when_to_use: Use when performing differential expression analysis on bottom-up mass spectrometry-based proteomics data, especially when analyzing single or multiple datasets simultaneously at the peptide level to increase statistical power, and when datasets contain missing peptide abundances that require model-based imputation.
- pitfalls: Do not use 0s in place of missing observations; they must be replaced with NAs and log2-transformed to avoid severely skewing the intensity distribution and producing invalid results ;; Ensure that the treatment group order is identical across all datasets being analyzed simultaneously (e.g., do not mix the order of control and treatment samples) ;; Avoid overnormalizing by removing too many bias trends (manually setting h.c too high), which can lead to overfitting ;; Do not perform Presence-Absence analysis on proteins that are already successfully analyzed in the Model-Based Differential Expression Analysis, as this would yield conflicting or redundant p-values

workflows.name: multi_dataset_proteomm_pipeline
workflows.intent: Perform peptide-level normalization, imputation, and differential expression analysis across multiple proteomics datasets.
input: dataset1_peptides.csv (Peptide intensity and metadata table for dataset 1)
dataset2_peptides.csv (Peptide intensity and metadata table for dataset 2)
workflows.stages: 1. Log2 transform and replace zeros with NAs using make_intencities and convert_log2 ;; 2. Extract metadata using make_meta ;; 3. Identify bias trends using eig_norm1 ;; 4. Perform EigenMS normalization using eig_norm2 ;; 5. Impute missing values using MBimpute ;; 6. Subset common and unique proteins using subset_proteins ;; 7. Perform combined model-based differential expression using prot_level_multi_part ;; 8. Perform single-dataset differential expression for unique proteins using peptideLevel_DE ;; 9. Identify presence/absence proteins using get_presAbs_prots ;; 10. Perform combined presence/absence analysis using prot_level_multiMat_PresAbs ;; 11. Perform single-dataset presence/absence analysis using peptideLevel_PresAbsDE
workflows.code:
data("hs_peptides")
intsCols = 8:13
m_logInts = make_intencities(hs_peptides, intsCols)
m_logInts = convert_log2(m_logInts)
metaCols = 1:7
m_prot.info = make_meta(hs_peptides, metaCols)
grps = as.factor(c('CG','CG','CG', 'mCG','mCG','mCG'))
hs_m_ints_eig1 = eig_norm1(m=m_logInts,treatment=grps,prot.info=m_prot.info)
hs_m_ints_eig1$h.c = 2
hs_m_ints_norm = eig_norm2(rv=hs_m_ints_eig1)
data("mm_peptides")
intsCols = 8:13
m_logInts = make_intencities(mm_peptides, intsCols)
m_logInts = convert_log2(m_logInts)
metaCols = 1:7
m_prot.info = make_meta(mm_peptides, metaCols)
mm_m_ints_eig1 = eig_norm1(m=m_logInts,treatment=grps,prot.info=m_prot.info)
mm_m_ints_eig1$h.c = 2
mm_m_ints_norm = eig_norm2(rv=mm_m_ints_eig1)
hs_prot.info = hs_m_ints_norm$normalized[,metaCols]
hs_norm_m =  hs_m_ints_norm$normalized[,intsCols]
imp_hs = MBimpute(hs_norm_m, grps, prot.info=hs_prot.info, pr_ppos=3, my.pi=0.05, compute_pi=FALSE)
mm_prot.info = mm_m_ints_norm$normalized[,1:7]
mm_norm_m =  mm_m_ints_norm$normalized[,8:13]
set.seed(12131)
imp_mm = MBimpute(mm_norm_m, grps, prot.info=mm_prot.info, pr_ppos=3, my.pi=0.05, compute_pi=FALSE)
mms = list()
treats = list()
protinfos = list()
mms[[1]] = imp_mm$y_imputed
mms[[2]] = imp_hs$y_imputed 
treats[[1]] = grps
treats[[2]] = grps
protinfos[[1]] = imp_mm$imp_prot.info 
protinfos[[2]] = imp_hs$imp_prot.info
subset_data = subset_proteins(mm_list=mms, prot.info=protinfos, 'MatchedID')
nperm = 50
comb_MBDE = prot_level_multi_part(mm_list=mms, treat=treats,prot.info=protinfos, prot_col_name='ProtID', nperm=nperm, dataset_suffix=c('MM', 'HS'))
mms_mm_dd = subset_data$sub_unique_mm_list[[1]]
protinfos_mm_dd = subset_data$sub_unique_prot.info[[1]] 
DE_mCG_CG_mm_dd = peptideLevel_DE(mms_mm_dd, grps, prot.info=protinfos_mm_dd, pr_ppos=2)
raw_list = list()
norm_imp_prot.info_list = list()
raw_list[[1]] = mm_m_ints_eig1$m
raw_list[[2]] = hs_m_ints_eig1$m
norm_imp_prot.info_list[[1]] = mm_m_ints_eig1$prot.info
norm_imp_prot.info_list[[2]] = hs_m_ints_eig1$prot.info
protnames_norm_list = list()
protnames_norm_list[[1]] = unique(mm_m_ints_norm$normalized$MatchedID)
protnames_norm_list[[2]] = unique(hs_m_ints_norm$normalized$MatchedID) 
presAbs_dd = get_presAbs_prots(mm_list=raw_list, prot.info=norm_imp_prot.info_list, protnames_norm=protnames_norm_list, prot_col_name=2)
ints_presAbs = list()
protmeta_presAbs = list()
ints_presAbs[[1]] = presAbs_dd[[1]][[1]]
ints_presAbs[[2]] = presAbs_dd[[1]][[2]]
protmeta_presAbs[[1]] = presAbs_dd[[2]][[1]] 
protmeta_presAbs[[2]] = presAbs_dd[[2]][[2]]
subset_presAbs = subset_proteins(mm_list=ints_presAbs, prot.info=protmeta_presAbs,'MatchedID') 
presAbs_comb=prot_level_multiMat_PresAbs(mm_list=subset_presAbs$sub_mm_list, treat=treats, prot.info=subset_presAbs$sub_prot.info, prot_col_name='MatchedID', nperm=nperm, dataset_suffix=c('MM', 'HS') )
mm_presAbs = peptideLevel_PresAbsDE(subset_presAbs$sub_unique_mm_list[[1]], treats[[1]], subset_presAbs$sub_unique_prot.info[[1]], pr_ppos=3)
hs_presAbs = peptideLevel_PresAbsDE(subset_presAbs$sub_unique_mm_list[[2]], treats[[2]], subset_presAbs$sub_unique_prot.info[[2]], pr_ppos=3)
